kind: 诊断查询：仅呈现归一化，非 agent 数据核实查询
sql:
SELECT count(*) AS joined_rows,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.projects_sections IS DISTINCT FROM g.projects_sections) AS section_string_different,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE list_sort(string_split(p.projects_sections, ', ')) IS DISTINCT FROM list_sort(string_split(g.projects_sections, ', '))) AS section_multiset_different,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.project_ids IS DISTINCT FROM g.project_ids OR p.project_names IS DISTINCT FROM g.project_names OR p.number_of_projects IS DISTINCT FROM g.number_of_projects OR p.projects_sections IS DISTINCT FROM g.projects_sections) AS baseline_row_scale,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.project_ids IS DISTINCT FROM g.project_ids OR p.project_names IS DISTINCT FROM g.project_names OR p.number_of_projects IS DISTINCT FROM g.number_of_projects OR list_sort(string_split(p.projects_sections, ', ')) IS DISTINCT FROM list_sort(string_split(g.projects_sections, ', '))) AS canonicalized_row_scale
FROM pred.intermediate.int_asana__task_projects p FULL JOIN gold.intermediate.int_asana__task_projects g USING(task_id)

tie_order_verification.sql: SELECT p.projects_sections,g.projects_sections FROM pred.intermediate.int_asana__task_projects p JOIN gold.intermediate.int_asana__task_projects g USING(task_id) WHERE p.projects_sections IS DISTINCT FROM g.projects_sections
tie_order_verification.method: 以逗号空格分项，首个 " (" 之前为 project_name；逐行比较 project_name 序列及每个 name 内完整项 multiset。原值不写入记录。
